_about: The topic matcher's labelled corpus (chat-block-spec §19.17): questions a visitor types on the chat page of site.az, each with what must answer it — one of the site's presets by name (preset:<name>), one faq item quoted (faq:<route> #<n>), or the model. Hostile and other-language questions are in it too: the matcher only ever picks among the author's answers, and stands aside when it is not sure. Read by packages/backend/test/chat-match-corpus.test.ts and pnpm bench:tokens.
